name: Gaussian Smoothing for Level-Set Extraction
definition: A fast smoothing method applied to binary volumes by converting to float, subtracting 0.5, and applying a Gaussian filter, which may destroy fine details.
summary: Gaussian Smoothing for Level-Set Extraction converts binary volumes into smooth fields for robust isosurface extraction, differing from constrained smoothing by using a faster, direct convolution approach that may destroy fine details.
